title: Goebel Hallmark Betsey Clark Praying Child Figurine 1972 W Germany Patchwork
conditionDescription: Three available; all pre-owned in a similar condition with no chips, cracks or repairs found and light crazing to the glaze underneath. Photos show one of the three - you will receive one figurine.
descriptionText:
Betsey Clark praying child figurine - made by Goebel, W. Germany, for Hallmark Cards, dated MCMLXXII (1972) on the underside. The little pajama-clad child kneeling with hands together on a patchwork quilt, in the soft matte Betsey Clark colors. About 4 inches tall. Goebel W. Germany and Hallmark marks on the base.

Condition: Three available; all pre-owned in a similar condition with no chips, cracks or repairs found and light crazing to the glaze underneath. Photos show one of the three - you will receive one figurine. Old price stickers on the underside. Please review all photos - they are of the actual figurines being sold.
